description: Free. The pump.fun wallet leaderboard, ranked by each wallet's own profit. (Oct 31: the follower ranking, sort copyable, is withdrawn until it is rebuilt at PumpSwap's real fees; at them, copying the best-scored wallets 1 slot behind lost money in six of seven weeks.) The wallets win over their whole record (took out 10+ SOL and 1% more than they put in over 20+ coin-weeks) and traded in the last ~20 days, each with why, its SOL in and out, its coins and its recent pace (trades a day, median hold). followable: true keeps the ones a copier can keep up with (under 20 trades a day, a median hold of 2 minutes or more, under half its trades fast). For: who should I copy trade, the best pump.fun traders, smart money wallets. Not pump.fun's own leaderboard, which ranks recent profit. Then wallet_records for any wallet's full record.

followable.description: only wallets a copier can keep up with; default false

limit.description: wallets to return, best first; default 25

sort.description: own (default): by the wallet's own profit; copyable: by what a follower 1 slot behind made, once a build charges PumpSwap's real fees (until then, own)

name: top_wallets
